title: Opus 5.5 Feels Creative
author: Aznshorty13
selftext:
Ive been working on this game for awhile (3 weeks), built pipelines/tools/context for the agents to use. And ive been having them record my preferences as weve been fine tuning bosses.

And then I was wondering if I just gave it a direction and creative freedom how would it do?

Was blown away. Ofc had to fine tune somethings, but the theme, feel, and base mechanics were from Opus 5.5. Excited for the future.

Tools Details:  
Stable Audio 3, Codex(Sol 6.1) for Image gen.

this is more vague but can you do some the top touhou bullet hell bosses. kinda want to make another boss. maybe we research record appropriately in the mech pipeline irganized appropriately  but xonly make the sandbox html for the curated one.  it will be a circle raid boss. i think illl just give you creative freedom. curious and hopeful to hiw you will make a boss  to how you wanna do it with circle raid in mind. have the description of the boss and theme too. dontt feel constrained do how you like. you can use api to make the concept image art that would bebused for the animated wallpaper. for the hover screen ehen selecting the boss.
